input_text: I have been keeping a journal for about two years. I write in it almost every night. Sometimes I write about what happened during the day. Other times I write about memories or ideas. The journal has become a mirror for my own thinking. When I read old entries I can see patterns I did not notice at the time. I see how certain worries repeated themselves and then faded. I see how some ideas grew slowly over months. Journaling has taught me that my own thoughts change more than I realize. What feels urgent today often looks different a few weeks later.
